2609.31136.title: Toward AI-Augmented Cooperative Engineering Workflows: Requirements and Architecture the European Rover Challenge
2609.31136.paper_summary: The growing availability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools creates new opportunities to support engineering design processes, yet their current use often remains limited to isolated tasks such as coding, documentation, or information retrieval. Less attention has been given to how AI can support cooperative engineering workflows at the process level, where teams must coordinate requirements, tasks, communication, knowledge transfer, and subsystem integration. This paper investigates this challenge in the context of the European Rover Challenge (ERC), where student teams design and integrate complex rover systems within a single academic cycle under strict time constraints and high subsystem interdependence. We conducted a role adaptive 40 question survey with ERC 2025 teams, yielding 104 responses from 14 teams. The survey examined team structure, knowledge transfer, task management, integration practices, communication patterns, and current AI usage. The results reveal recurring workflow bottlenecks, including limited documentation, unclear requirements, fragmented communication, informal task monitoring, and substantial integration rework. Based on these findings, we derive requirements for AI augmented cooperative engineering work-flows and propose an initial assistant system architecture that connects user facing interfaces, credential management, service selection, specialized AI services, and external engineering tools. The proposed architecture aims to support task clarification, requirement and compliance management, communication summarization, integration risk detection, and continuous knowledge capture. In doing so, the paper contributes empirical requirements and an architectural direction for AI augmented cooperative engineering workflows in hybrid human AI team settings.
2609.31136.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）工具的日益普及為支持工程設計過程創造了新的機會，但它們目前的使用往往僅限於孤立的任務，例如編碼、文檔或信息檢索。對於AI如何在過程層面支持協作工程工作流程的關注較少，在這裡，團隊必須協調需求、任務、溝通、知識轉移和子系統集成。本文在歐洲探測器挑戰賽（ERC）的背景下探討了這一挑戰，學生團隊在嚴格的時間限制和高子系統相互依賴的情況下設計和集成複雜的探測器系統，並在單一學術周期內完成。 我們對ERC 2025團隊進行了一項角色適應性的40題調查，共收集到來自14個團隊的104份回應。該調查考察了團隊結構、知識轉移、任務管理、集成實踐、溝通模式和當前的AI使用情況。結果揭示了反覆出現的工作流程瓶頸，包括文檔有限、需求不明、溝通碎片化、任務監控不正式以及大量的集成返工。根據這些發現，我們推導出AI增強的協作工程工作流程的需求，並提出了一個初步的助手系統架構，該架構連接用戶界面、憑證管理、服務選擇、專門的AI服務和外部工程工具。所提議的架構旨在支持任務澄清、需求和合規管理、溝通摘要、集成風險檢測和持續的知識捕獲。通過這樣做，本文為在混合人類與AI團隊環境中增強的協作工程工作流程提供了實證需求和架構方向。
